subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should editable `MEMORY.md`, `USER.md`, and daily-note access ship as a dedicated core Control UI memory panel, as part of the generic workspace-file manager, or through a plugin-owned Control UI contribution surface?
rationale: Current main only partially satisfies the request through generic allowlisted files, while the missing daily-note and memory-specific UX crosses security, session-state, and product ownership boundaries.

options.title: Keep product/security review open
options.body: Leave this issue open until maintainers choose the owner boundary and access model before implementation.

options.title: Fold into workspace file manager
options.body: Make the broader `agents.workspace.*` API and Workspace tab the canonical path, then close this only after it covers memory-note access safely.

options.title: Route through plugin UI slots
options.body: Use this as a motivating memory/context-panel case for the Control UI contribution-slot RFC instead of adding a bespoke core panel now.

recommendation.title: Keep product/security review open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until maintainers choose the owner boundary and access model before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the most direct recent history on the current `agents.files` boundary and adjacent Control UI files surface.
